[[File:Hops patch.gif|left|thumb|Hops growing in the vineyard.]]
<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> are a type of crop that is grown from [[hops seed]]s in the [[vineyard]]. Alternatively, they can be bought directly from the [[Miller]]. Hops are an improvable crop, meaning they have a variety of quality levels and can be improved upon with fertilizer. The quality of the hops will affect the quality of the products made from it. For more information, see [[farming]].

==Alchemy==
Hops can be decomposed to solution and powder at the [[hand mixer]] and [[alchemy mill]], respectively. Having unlocked [[Anatomy and Alchemy (Tech Tree)|Master of Alchemy]] produces one additional reagent at each workstation.
